thread:
sam: Heads-up — AcmeCorp escalated. Their per-model throughput panels in the Console read 0 QPS for several models starting ~11:20 but the API returns 200s. They’re seeing increased latency and retries. ticket: https://tickets.redwood/INC-9876 :exclamation:
lisa: Link? customer saying billing jump too — worried about cost impact. :grimace:
sam: https://tickets.redwood/INC-9876 — says graphs dropped to flatline right after a deploy at 11:15. No errors in API logs, just more 5xx-to-200 retries from client side.
jules: I can look at Prometheus and the dashboard queries. Which dashboard?
kevin: grabbing metrics — noticed exporter pushed a new label set in the latest telemetry agent (v2.3.0) around 11:12. Quick sample:
```
# before (v2.2.x)
model_throughput{model="gpt-medium",region="us-west"} 124
# after (v2.3.0)
model_throughput{model_id="gpt-medium",region="us-west"} 124
```
kevin: dashboards and alerts filter on `model` label; since exporter renamed it to `model_id` panels show empty/0.
mina: ugh — was that label rename in the changelog? I thought we kept stable labels. Which PR?
kevin: PR #2734 changed label naming to avoid clash with upstream libs. Deployed in telemetry agent 2.3.0. It was rolled to prod at 11:10-ish.
jules: That explains it. Quick remediation options: (A) revert exporter relabeling roll, (B) update Grafana queries to use `model_id` OR (C) add a Prometheus relabel config to copy `model_id` -> `model`. Which should we do for fastest customer impact?
lisa: Customer needs immediate visibility. What’s fastest with lowest blast radius?
kevin: Short-term: add relabel rule on Prometheus scrape config to set `model=$1` from `model_id` using action: replace. That avoids touching dashboards/alerts. Mid-term: update dashboards and alerting to use canonical label `model_id` and ship a telemetry fix note.
ops-bot: CI/CD: rolling config change to prometheus-scrape in staging...
jules: I can push the relabel in staging and validate panels. If green, roll to prod.
sam: please also add a note in the support ticket and ping AcmeCorp — they asked for ETA.
kevin: repro steps I used to confirm:
1) curl http://prometheus:9090/api/v1/query?query=model_throughput
2) grep for `model=` vs `model_id=`
3) inspect grafana panel query for `label_values(model_throughput, model)` — returns empty now.

kevin: sample commands:
```bash
curl -sG 'http://prometheus:9090/api/v1/query' --data-urlencode 'query=label_values(model_throughput, model)' | jq '.'
# returns [] after 11:12, returns values before deploy
```
mina: staging relabel applied, dashboards in staging show restored numbers. ops-bot: will you promote to prod?
ops-bot: Prometheus config change approved by oncall, deploying to prod in 2 minutes.
ops-bot: prod deploy done.
jules: Confirming Console panels — I see QPS back for affected models. Charts repopulating. :tada:
sam: Noted in ticket, told AcmeCorp we restored graphs and we’re planning a follow-up to update dashboards & alerts. They appreciated the quick fix but want a rollback in history to see past graphs mapped to model label.
kevin: For timeline + root cause: PR #2734 renamed `model`->`model_id` to avoid collisions. We missed a compatibility migration step for dashboards/alerts. Action items:
- kevin: open telemetry patch to add a compatibility label (copy `model_id`->`model`) in exporter for two releases.
- mina & jules: update Grafana dashboards and alert rules to use `model_id` and remove hack after telemetry change stabilizes.
- support (sam/lisa): follow up with AcmeCorp about billing/latency notes and ask if they want retroactive graph mapping exported.
customer_ops: Customer thankful for fast resolution but asked for a postmortem and an explanation of why alerts didn’t fire (alert used `model` label).
sam: Will draft a short incident note and assign postmortem. Thanks all for quick turn. :heart:
